title: Roll out reranker v2 to all search traffic
text: This turns on reranker v2 (the cross-encoder model) for 100% of search requests, up from the 5% experiment. Offline NDCG@10 is +4.1% over v1. Batch size is set to 64 to keep GPU utilisation high. Rollout is behind the reranker_v2 flag so we can turn it off. Reviewers: @lortiz @pramam.

title: Smaller inference batches and a candidate embedding cache for ranking
text: Fixes INC-4821, a regression from PR 1187. Reranker v2 with batch size 64 queued requests behind each other under peak load, which pushed tail latency up. This PR rolls the batch size back to 16 and adds an LRU cache for candidate embeddings so repeat queries skip the encoder. Load test: p95 back to 175 ms at 2x peak traffic. Deployed with search-api v4.12.2.

title: Add reranker v1 behind experiment flag
text: First reranker for search results: a small gradient-boosted model over BM25 features. Runs on CPU. Shipped to 10% of traffic as an experiment. p95 latency impact in the experiment was +6 ms.

title: Use the new tax service client in checkout
text: Replaces the old HTTP tax client with the new pooled client. Pool size 8 per pod. Timeout stays at 2 s.

title: Raise tax client pool size and add retry
text: Fixes INC-4902. The new tax client's pool of 8 connections was exhausted at peak, so requests waited and hit the 2 s timeout. Pool size is now 32 and one retry is added for connection timeouts.

title: Bulk indexer for catalog updates
text: Writes catalog changes to the search index in batches of 5000 to cut indexing cost.

title: Move personalised recs to feature store v2 schema
text: Reads user features from the v2 schema. Reviewed by Ama Mensah and Jin Park. Old schema readers removed.

title: Fix empty personalised carousel
text: Fixes INC-4877. Feature store v2 uses user_key instead of user_id, so every lookup missed and the model returned nothing. Map the key correctly and fall back to popular items when features are missing.

title: Apple Pay on web checkout
text: Adds the Apple Pay button to web checkout for Safari users.

title: Fix facet counts for out-of-stock filter
text: Facet counts included out-of-stock items when the in-stock filter was on.

title: Reranker v2 shadow-mode metrics
text: Logs reranker v2 scores next to v1 in shadow mode so we can compare offline. No user impact.

title: Reranker v2 Spanish model
text: Adds a Spanish cross-encoder for reranker v2 on the Mexico site. Batch size 16.

title: Reranker v1: freshness feature
text: Adds days-since-launch as a reranker v1 feature.

title: Reranker v2 experiment at 5%
text: Raises the reranker v2 experiment from 1% to 5%. Experiment p95 latency +9 ms at 5%.

title: Configurable reranker v2 batch size
text: Reranker v2 batch size becomes a config value, default 32. Larger batches use the GPU better.

title: Reranker v2 October model refresh
text: Retrains reranker v2 on September click data. Offline NDCG@10 +0.8%.

title: Seasonal synonyms for search
text: Adds a synonyms file for seasonal terms.

title: Configurable bulk indexer batch size
text: Batch size for the catalog bulk indexer is now a config value, default 1000. Large batches made each write slow.

title: Publish JWKS before key activation
text: Fixes INC-4655. The rotation job now publishes the new public key and waits for all verifiers before signing with it.

title: One-typo spelling correction
text: Corrects queries with one typo using the product title dictionary.

title: Per-order tax rounding
text: Fixes INC-4733.

title: Rename wishlist items field
text: Renames 'items' to 'entries'.

title: Structured query logs
text: Logs search queries as JSON for analytics.

title: Carousel A/B test framework
text: Lets the homepage carousel run experiments.

title: Colour terms in query understanding
text: Maps colour words to the colour facet.

title: Canadian postal code formatter
text: Fixes INC-4940.

title: Saved cards for guest checkout
text: Guests can save a card with a one-time code.
